title: The emblem as infinity symbol
statement: Per the canon, the emblem seen on the craft — the swastika within the Star of David — signifies infinity: the hexagram as 'as it is above, so it is below' (space) and the swastika as the cycle, infinity in time; the corpus records the reading together with the symbols' documented deep histories (the swastika's twelve-millennia cross-cultural distribution; the hexagram's own history), and with the modern catastrophe of the swastika's Nazi appropriation registered plainly as the reception context any use of the symbol now carries.

includes: The canonical reading: the composite emblem as the two infinities — the emblematization of the frame recorded as woh-claim-0023 (space) with the temporal cycle the woh-claim-0014 apparatus reads alongside
The distribution layer, documented: the swastika's ancient and cross-cultural spread (Hindu, Buddhist, Jain, and archaeological attestations) and the hexagram's history, each at its own strength

The reception discipline: the Nazi appropriation is registered as the governing modern context — the corpus explains the canon's reading and the movement's later emblem revisions without minimizing the appropriation or its weight
excludes: Any claim that the ancient distribution evidences the canon's reading; ubiquity of a simple rotational form has independent explanations, carried as the default
Apologetics for public display; the record explains a reading, and display questions are the movement's, not the corpus's
Sacred-geometry numerology beyond the canon's stated meanings
Trivialization of the appropriation, which is a named trigger

source_references.locator: TBWTT-3:288 (the emblem: 'as it is above, so it is below'); TBWTT-3:305 (the swastika as infinity in time, 'the most ancient symbol')
ETTMTTP-2:24 (the cycle sign in numerous ancient writings)
The academic account of the emblem controversy and the movement's revisions

alternatives.statement: The swastika's ubiquity is the ubiquity of a simple rotational motif in weaving, pottery, and sun symbolism; no shared meaning travels with the shape.
After the twentieth century the symbol's public meaning is fixed by the appropriation; ancient readings cannot be communicated past it, whatever their merits.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0020 or woh-claim-0023 is revised in a way that affects the emblem's provenance or referent.
The canon's fuller context changes the stated meanings.
Public prose begins treating distribution as evidence, minimizing the appropriation, or extending into numerology — all named exclusions.
